who_pays: Plato's Closet - the store pays you directly on the spot, in cash.
who_qualifies: You must own the items and visit a Plato's Closet store in person - no appointment needed. Each store decides independently what to buy based on its inventory.
work_available: Yes - stores were buying on the spot as of 2026-09-23. But they are highly selective: only current styles in great condition, and most of what you bring can be declined.
what_gets_accepted: Staff review for style, condition, brand, and demand - only currently-in-style, gently-used clothing, shoes, and accessories are bought. Per-item payouts are a few dollars, so pre-sort ruthlessly.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; no shipping since you bring items in. Your unpaid time is pre-sorting, washing, and folding - presentation influences the buy - plus the trip to the store.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash on the spot for the items they accept - no appointment needed, one trip.
